correctness.rationale: Starting empty at d=0, the complement-even-sites transformation maps pair 00↔11 updates to exclusion exchanges and proves irreducibility in equal U/V count class; for d>0 physical exchanges and pair removal make all even-total parity configurations accessible. Detailed balance yields Bernoulli(p) conditioned on the relevant class. U and V are conditionally independent given shared count K at d=0, so I=H(K), with probability proportional to binom(m,j)^2 z^(2j). With d>0 they are conditionally independent given shared parity and I=h(q_m), q_m=(1+t^m)^2/(2(1+t^(2m))). Standard local CLT yields H(K)=0.5 log(pi e m p(1-p))+o(1) at fixed p, versus log2 as m→∞ for d>0; mp→λ gives the Bessel count limit. Independently enumerated m=2..4 microstate distributions and computed MI at three densities.
residual_risks: Asymptotic local-CLT proof requires uniform tail entropy control supplied by factorial/binomial estimates; finite tests alone do not prove these limits.

evidence: Mercado, Jung, Kim, Garcia, Nonaka and Bell, Surface Coverage Dynamics for Reversible Dissociative Adsorption on Finite Linear Lattices, arXiv:2212.12286v1 gives mean coverage and nearest-neighbor correlations, not global interlaced-half mutual information.

Wilms, Troyer and Verstraete, Mutual information in classical spin models, arXiv:1011.4421 treats information in different spin-model geometries; Mobilia, Exact multipoint and multitime correlation functions of a one-dimensional model of adsorption and evaporation of dimers, arXiv:cond-mat/0204148 time-dependent multipoint functions.
broader_coverage.reasoning: Local two-point correlations or generic spin-model entropy do not compute the global mutual information H(K) or parity entropy for these exact dynamics without the new charge-conditioning step. Broader conditional-Bernoulli literature might contain an equivalent theorem and remains a risk.

originality.rationale: Mercado et al. establish and enumerate the relevant stationary configuration classes and hopping singularity, so the ensemble is not new. The assessed information-theoretic consequence is the exact mutual-information reduction to a count or a parity bit, its growing-vs-one-bit scaling and Bessel dilute crossover. These statements are absent from the inspected model results; the logical derivation from published ensemble weights is explicitly acknowledged.
residual_risks: Information of shared conserved charges is a standard entropy mechanism and a specialized exact conditioned-ensemble result may already include these identities.
Stationary limit as d↓0 is singular, not a claim of instantaneous or mixing-time discontinuity; fixed-density log law fails in sparse regimes, which are treated separately.

value.rationale: Reveals that arbitrarily weak diffusion opens an accessible configuration class that collapses global information between interlaced physical halves from order log m to one parity bit; the exact sparse-density Bessel crossover and proper-subset independence show local diagnostics cannot see this global structure. It is a natural invariant of a previously studied solvable stochastic adsorption model, despite reusing known equilibrium weights.
residual_risks: No temporal MI or mixing-time estimate is derived; information novelty is explicitly a consequence of known stationary ensembles.
